ASTROTECH REPORTS FIRST QUARTER OF FISCAL YEAR 2027 FINANCIAL RESULTS

 

Austin, Texas – November 13, 2026 – Astrotech Corporation (Nasdaq: ASTC) (the “Company” or “Astrotech”) reported its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, which ended September 30, 2026.

 

First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Highlights

 

 

●

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had deployed the TRACER 1000 in approximately 38 locations in 17 countries across the United States, Europe, Central America and Asia.

 

 

●

Total operating expenses were $3.1 million, a decline of 15.7% during the first quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to the first quarter ended September 30, 2025.

 

 

●

Astrotech’s consolidated balance sheet consisted of $11.6 million in working capital as of September 30, 2026, supporting the Company’s ongoing operations and strategic priorities.

 

 

●

In collaboration with Skycorp Incorporated, Astrotech submitted a proposal to NASA under the NextSTEP-3 Lunar Enabling Infrastructure Accelerator (“LEIA”) program to advance the Astrotech Mobile Power System (“AMPS”) from Technology Readiness Level (“TRL”) 4 to TRL 6. Designed to deliver 6 kW of continuous power (10 kW surge) for lunar polar environments, the project, if selected by NASA, would culminate in an integrated system test at Astrotech’s Austin, Texas facility, where Astrotech would manage facilities, procurement, and program finances. While the proposal was recently submitted and there can be no assurance that NASA will select the project for funding, an award would provide Astrotech with needed non-dilutive capital to accelerate its lunar infrastructure initiatives.

 

“Our first-quarter results reflect the dedication of our team and executing against our strategic priorities,” stated Thomas B. Pickens, III, Astrotech’s Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and Chief Technology Officer. “As we look ahead to the remainder of fiscal year 2027, we remain focused on disciplined execution, investing in opportunities that strengthen our business, and creating long-term value for our shareholders.”

 

About Astrotech Corporation

 

Astrotech (Nasdaq: ASTC) is a mass spectrometry company that creates, operates, and scales innovative businesses through its wholly owned subsidiaries. Each subsidiary leverages Astrotech’s core technology to serve specialized markets:

 

 

●

1st Detect develops, manufactures, and markets trace detection systems for security and narcotics screening applications.
 

●

AgLAB designs process analyzers tailored to the agriculture industry.
 

●

Pro-Control produces solutions for in-situ chemical process control in industrial manufacturing.
 

●

EN-SCAN, Inc. develops, manufactures and sells portable, ruggedized gas chromatography-based environmental testing solutions, including the Labrador HH-GC.
 

●

Lunar Utilities Corporation is focused on potentially developing infrastructure technologies that could support semiconductor processing, advanced computing systems, and quantum computing manufacturing operations on the lunar surface.

 

Astrotech is headquartered in Austin, Texas. For more information, visit www.astrotechcorp.com
